title: Korean Beef Skewers with Sweet Smoky Glaze
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional Mexican skewers, featuring Korean marinated beef and a sweet smoky glaze.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, green chili flakes, and lime juice.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated beef and diced pear onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and season with smoky chili powder.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Brush the skewers with argentinian chimichurri during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional pear slices if desired.
